- Option A: Tue, Nov 30 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (1:00–1:30 PM ET)
- Option B: Wed, Dec 1 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT (5:00–5:30 PM ET)
- Option C: Thu, Dec 2 — 11:30–12:00 PM PT (2:30–3:00 PM ET)

Who from your side should join? For the technical portion I’d recommend your platform lead (or an engineer familiar with your model serving) plus a product stakeholder for success criteria alignment. I’ll bring Marissa (Solutions Engineer) and myself.

Attached is a short overview deck and a draft mutual action plan so you can see the proposed timeline and checklist.

If you confirm a slot I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a brief agenda.

Thanks —
